beat 'done' narration: 'Với nén đường và hợp theo kích thước, mỗi phép tốn gần như O(1) (hàm Ackermann ngược)' — the inverse Ackermann function is α(n), and the amortized cost is O(α(n)), which is 'gần như O(1)' — correct, but the narration does not mention that this is amortized, which could mislead students into thinking each individual operation is O(1)
